title: Recursion error on array of non-native postgres array of enums

labels.name: datatypes
labels.description: things to do with database types, like VARCHAR and others

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
**Describe the bug**
A recursion error is raised while trying to create the bind processor for an array of pg enums. Using the non-pg enums works fine
**Expected behavior**
Everything works as expected

**To Reproduce**

```py
import sqlalchemy as sa
import sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql as sa_pg
import enum

class AnEnum(enum.Enum):
    A = 1
    B = 2
    C = 3

metadata = sa.MetaData()
t = sa.Table(
    "table_1",
    metadata,
    sa.Column("id", sa.Integer, primary_key=True),
    sa.Column("data", sa_pg.ARRAY(sa_pg.ENUM(AnEnum, native_enum=False))),
)
engine = sa.create_engine("postgresql://scott:tiger@127.0.0.1:5432/test", echo=True)
metadata.drop_all(engine)
metadata.create_all(engine)
with engine.connect() as conn:
    conn.execute(t.insert(), [{"data": [AnEnum.A, AnEnum.B]}])
```

 - Python: 3.8
 - SQLAlchemy: master
 - Database: postgres

**Additional context**
works fine on 1.3
